fileNodes.name: App.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Main application root component (4431 lines). Orchestrates the entire Voxel Blade build calculator UI including weapon/armor/ring/rune selection modals, enchantment management, drag-and-drop equipment reordering, build state display, tab switching between Overview and Analyze views, and summary statistics. Imports the damage calculation engine, game data, and dozens of child components.

fileNodes.name: BuffList.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Buff/debuff/neutral effect display component (783 lines). Computes active buffs from equipped items, perks, weapon arts, and draconic infusion. Groups duplicate buffs, applies perk modifiers, handles DoT display potency, and provides a tabbed UI (Buffs/Debuffs/Neutral) with expand/collapse. Displays potency, duration, sources, and effect descriptions.

fileNodes.name: BuildSaves.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Build save/load management component (1098 lines). Handles localStorage persistence of build slots, import/export with deflate compression, drag-to-reorder, fuzzy search across saved builds, duplicate detection, and build state serialization/deserialization with key mapping and sanitization.

fileNodes.name: DamageAnalyzer.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Detailed damage analysis component (7015 lines, largest file in project). Computes full damage breakdowns per attack type (M1, M2, WA, Rune, Perk), applies buff/debuff multipliers, calculates DoT ticks, defense mitigation, weapon charge, scaling breakdowns, self-damage, summon damage, and healing. Provides interactive toggles for individual buffs, boosts, and debuffs.

fileNodes.name: AppHeader.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Application header component (175 lines). Displays the VoxlBuilder title, embeds the BuildSaves panel, and provides a tab switcher between Overview and Analyze views with an animated sliding bubble indicator. Supports keyboard shortcut (Tab) to toggle between views.
